name: g_Game
evidence: Passed as the Game/GameSession object to Game_* helpers; owns current player index at +0x2ec, player map at +0x200 and clock at +0x94.

name: g_LanguageStringCount
evidence: First dword of language.ldf; Language_LoadLDF allocates this many string pointers.

name: g_LanguageStrings
evidence: char** table of every language.ldf string; Language_CopyStringIds copies from it and Language_MapStrings aliases entries.

name: g_LanguageFileBuffer
evidence: Raw language.ldf allocation read by Language_LoadLDF.

name: g_MissionGoalTexts
evidence: 44-entry char* table filled by UI_LoadStringTable with Language_CopyStringIds; Mission_UpdateObjectivesPanel indexes it by goal id.

name: g_MissionGoalUiFlags
evidence: 44-entry dword table consulted by Mission_UpdateObjectivesPanel for goal ids 0 and 15.

name: g_MissionGoalTextAnchor
evidence: Initialised from g_LanguageStrings[0x115c/4] (language index 1111, 'Build a Level 3 HQ'); UI_LoadStringTable copies 44 consecutive strings from this anchor into g_MissionGoalTexts.

name: g_UIRootWindow
evidence: Root passed to UI_CreateWindow, UI_FindWindowByID and Window_ProcessMessageQueue.

name: g_ResourceManager
evidence: Handle passed to Resource_Open/Read/Close, including language.ldf.

name: g_Renderer
evidence: Display object passed to FullscreenImage_Load and Surface_LockPrimary; released through its first virtual slot in the shutdown path.

name: g_GameWorld
evidence: Game_Construct result; Map_LoadIsodata loads the city into it and game code stores the scenario flag at +0xafd2.

name: g_DebugConsole
evidence: First argument of DebugConsole_Printf and moved through Window_MoveToSidePanel.

name: s_EmptyText
evidence: Alias of g_LanguageStrings[0x10]; language.ldf index 16 is a single space, used as default dialog/format text.

name: s_FormatInt
evidence: Bytes at this address are '%d'.

name: s_FormatMoney
evidence: Bytes at this address are '%d $'.

name: s_FormatString
evidence: Bytes at this address are '%s'.

name: g_SoundManager
evidence: First argument of Sound_PlayMissionSpeech and Sound_UpdateListener; sound subsystem singleton.

name: g_CurrentMissionIndex
evidence: Used as the mission-list key for the city ini name and mission text; Mission_UpdateObjectivesPanel compares it with 8.

name: g_GameScreenState
evidence: Assigned stage values (3/4/5) by Game_CompleteMissionStage and compared with 7 by the briefing screen.

name: g_IsFreePlay
evidence: Non-campaign start path sets it to 1; free-play branches use different goal thresholds, no tutorial speech, and different mission-stage completion.
